question: List every outbound endpoint the backend (apps/web/convex) can call, with file:line and scheme: Bedrock (AWS SDK bedrock-runtime), Vertex (Google GenAI SDK), OpenAI chat completions / vision (selectable as provider 'openai' and visionProvider 'openai'), OpenAI transcription, the live-session key minting call, SES, the Specode email relay, SITE_URL use, and any other fetch() or SDK client. For each: is the URL hard-coded https, built from an env var (name it), or an SDK default? Record the env overrides Tim must read (their names) in notDecidableByCode.

rule.pass: every hard-coded endpoint is https:// and every other one is an SDK default (https) or an env override
basis: One http:// endpoint or env override in use = Fail, quoted with the file or variable

halves.env overrides on the deployment: CONFIG (Tim reads each scheme): not run in this lane
halves.unused paths on the deployment: CONFIG (Tim): not run in this lane

answers.answer:
The code passes. Every outbound call in apps/web/convex uses https, set in one of three ways:
- **Hard-coded https:** OpenAI transcription posts by fetch() to "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions" (transcribe.ts:12/156). SES requests are signed by the code itself and built as `https://${host}` with host = email.<region>.amazonaws.com; AWS_SES_REGION or AWS_REGION only picks the region, never the scheme (ses.ts:39/89/101/120).
- **SDK default (https):** Bedrock uses a BedrockRuntimeClient with no endpoint set (bedrock.ts:85). Vertex uses a GoogleGenAI client with vertexai=true and no base URL (vertex.ts:150). OpenAI chat and vision use `new OpenAI({ apiKey })` with no baseURL (openai.ts:92). Live-session key minting calls client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on an OpenAI client with no baseURL (transcribe.ts:71-74). Each of these can still be redirected by an env var the SDK reads itself: OPENAI_BASE_URL, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL / AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME, and the GenAI SDK's base-URL vars.
- **Built from an env var:** the Specode relay does fetch(SPECODE_EMAIL_RELAY_URL) (email.ts:18/25). It only runs when AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER is not "ses" and SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE is "platform"; when AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses it is never reached.

The scheme-relevant http:// literal in the code is the dev fallback `process.env.SITE_URL ?? "http://localhost:5173"` (auth.ts:105). The backend never fetches that value. It is used as the crossDomain siteUrl and a trusted origin, so it is not an outbound endpoint under the question's rule. It would only apply if SITE_URL were unset, which is part of Tim's env check. The only other http strings are origin-matching patterns, not endpoints. Provider choice is 'openai' | 'bedrock' and visionProvider 'openai' | 'vertex' (providers/index.ts:23/26); which one the aiProvider row picks is a data question. No recorded gaps or open questions are involved.

The code passes. Every outbound call in apps/web/convex either uses a hard-coded https:// URL or relies on an SDK default, which is https. The only other kind is a URL taken from an env var, and its scheme can only be checked on the deployment.

The calls:
- **OpenAI transcription:** hard-coded https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions (transcribe.ts:12, called with fetch at :156).
- **OpenAI chat completions and vision:** the OpenAI SDK with no baseURL in code (openai.ts:92). The SDK default is https://api.openai.com/v1, though the SDK also reads OPENAI_BASE_URL. It is selectable as provider 'openai' and visionProvider 'openai' (providers/index.ts:23,26).
- **Live-session key minting:** the OpenAI SDK, realtime.clientSecrets.create (transcribe.ts:71-74). The default is https.
- **Bedrock:** BedrockRuntimeClient with region only and no endpoint (bedrock.ts:85). The SDK default is https://bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com, unless AWS_ENDPOINT_URL or AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME is set.
- **Vertex:** GoogleGenAI with vertexai:true and no baseUrl (vertex.ts:150). The SDK default is https.
- **SES:** a hand-signed fetch to `https://email.${region}.amazonaws.com` (ses.ts:39, :89), with the region from AWS_SES_REGION or AWS_REGION. The scheme is fixed to https.
- **Specode relay:** fetch to process.env.SPECODE_EMAIL_RELAY_URL (email.ts:18,25). It is used only when AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER is not "ses" and SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE is "platform" (email.ts:52-57).

No other fetch() call or SDK client exists. SITE_URL is never called: it serves only as the auth redirect and trusted-origin value. Its code fallback is "http://localhost:5173" (auth.ts:105), a local-development default rather than an outbound endpoint. It matters only if SITE_URL is unset on the deployment, which Tim checks. No open questions or recorded gaps apply.
